title: [v0.92.1][AWS-F] AWS Runtime platform modules
body:
## Outcome

Produce one reviewed AWS Runtime platform-module set.

## Primary deliverable

One reviewed Terraform module set for private Runtime network, edge, build, and independently scalable node groups.

## Verification result

Saved-plan, private-connectivity, exact Runtime artifact, cost, observability, rollback, and zero-residue disposable-deployment checks pass without production traffic.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one reviewed Runtime platform-module set; module components and the disposable proving deployment are implementation parts and evidence inputs.

## Dependencies

- AWS-E: #488
- issue-122: #122

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Runtime hosts have no direct public ingress
- [ ] Shared edge network build and node states remain separated
- [ ] Existing issue 122 owns public Route53 and ACM exposure
- [ ] Disposable deployment and cleanup bind the exact modules

## Owned paths

- `infra/aws/runtime/**`
- `docs/operations/cloud/aws/runtime-platform/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/aws-f/**`

## PVF lanes

- `saved-plan`
- `private-connectivity`
- `runtime-artifact`
- `cost-and-deadline`
- `observability`
- `cleanup-zero`

## Stop conditions

- Issue 122 authority is contradicted
- Public ingress appears unexpectedly
- Production traffic would be required

## Non-goals

- Production cutover
- Domain transfer
- Runtime behavior fork
